title: Sweet potato and feta gratin
blurb: Layers of sweet potato with peppers, spinach and feta, topped with breadcrumbs
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C. Peel the sweet potatoes and slice them into rounds about 3mm thick.
Deseed the pepper and cut it into thin strips. Peel and finely slice the garlic.
Heat half the olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat and cook the pepper strips for 5 minutes until softened. Add the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted, then remove from the heat.
Arrange half the sweet potato slices in a small baking dish, slightly overlapping. Season with black pepper.
Spread the pepper and spinach mixture over the sweet potatoes, scatter over the garlic, then crumble half the feta on top.
Layer the remaining sweet potato slices over the filling and pour the cream evenly over the top.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the remaining olive oil and scatter over the surface. Crumble the remaining feta on top.
Bake for 35 minutes until the sweet potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife and the top is golden.
